findings.claim: Every car makes a new TrackPos object on every sim tick. stepCars sets `car.pos = trackPosition(...)`, and trackPosition gets its result from nearestLocal→projectOnSegment, which returns a fresh object literal. When a car is off the track, nearestGlobal (called from trackPosition and from surfaceAt) allocates one or two more. The old car.pos is thrown away right after: nothing keeps a reference to it between ticks.
findings.evidence: src/sim/track.ts:491 `return { seg: i, s: ..., lateral, distance: Math.hypot(x - px, z - pz) };` (projectOnSegment, reached from nearestLocal:538 and nearestGlobal:505). src/sim/car.ts:290 `car.pos = trackPosition(track, car.x, car.z, car.pos);`, car.ts:291 surfaceAt → track.ts:566 `nearestGlobal(track, x, z).distance` (a TrackPos used for one field). Readers of car.pos all read it within the tick: world.ts:89/128/140 (`.s`), bot.ts:95-131 (`.seg`, `.s`, `.lateral`). No match in src/ for structuredClone or spreads of car/pos, and src/driver does not read pos. perf.json: the sim's other hot functions are allocation-free in source (scratch `hit`, `seg`, `ground`, `nearby`), so this is one of the few real per-tick allocation sites left on the stepCars path, at 6 cars × 60 Hz.
findings.suggestedFix: Add an optional `out: TrackPos` parameter to projectOnSegment/nearestLocal/trackPosition, defaulting to a fresh object so the existing tests in tests/sim/track.test.ts:250-287 are unaffected. In trackPosition, write the local result into `prev` only after `prev.seg` has been read. Use one module scratch TrackPos for the global candidate and copy it into `out` only if it wins. In surfaceAt, use a scratch for the nearestGlobal distance check. Every number stays the same. Wait for in-flight PR #35, which also edits src/sim/car.ts.

confirmations.note: src/game.ts:202: draw() still calls `const view = raceView(r.world);` every rendered frame. world.ts:138-157 still allocates the distances map, positions, the racers map and, on pickup tracks, `p.respawn.map`. B08 and B09, which the audit was waiting on, have both merged (#30, #31).

src/game.ts:197-198 still does `r.prev = r.curr; r.curr = carViews(r.world);`. world.ts:133-134 `world.cars.map((car) => carView(car, world.track))` and car.ts:145-155 still build a new CarView per car every tick. perf.json still shows carView at 791 B/frame (bends) and 802 B/frame (hay-loop).
